findings.current: The moment the words left Jin Taekyung’s mouth, Wu Heixing almost forgot his rising anger and shouted.
findings.defect: The draft makes Wu Heixing only almost forget his anger and leaves it unclear whether he actually shouted. The source says he forgot his anger and nearly shouted.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly marks forgetting the anger as completed and the shout as the action that almost occurred.
findings.replacement: The moment the words left Jin Taekyung’s mouth, Wu Heixing forgot his rising anger and nearly shouted.
findings.source: 진태경의 입에서 그 단어가 흘러나온 순간, 우헤이싱은 치밀어오르는 분노도 잊은 채 소리칠 뻔했다.

findings.current: Even if a hundred thousand or a million people disappeared, it would still be no more than a drop in the ocean.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the source’s image of a handful with a drop in the ocean.
findings.rationale: The source uses 한 줌, literally and figuratively “a handful,” to express how dismissively Wu views the deaths.
findings.replacement: Even if a hundred thousand or a million people disappeared, they would amount to no more than a handful.
findings.source: 십만, 백만이 사라진다 한들 한 줌에 불과하다.

findings.current: In fact, if that damn bangzi became the vanguard of the suicide squad and burned gloriously, Wu Heixing would be more than happy to celebrate with both hands raised.
findings.defect: “Burned gloriously” is a literal calque that can incorrectly suggest immolation. Here 산화하다 is a euphemism for dying a heroic death.
findings.rationale: Nothing in the source says Jin would physically burn; the phrase describes glorious death in battle.
findings.replacement: In fact, if that damn bangzi became the vanguard of the suicide squad and died a glorious death, Wu Heixing would be more than happy to celebrate with both hands raised.
findings.source: 오히려 저 빌어먹을 빵즈 놈이 결사대의 선봉이 되어 장렬하게 산화한다면 쌍수를 들고 기뻐해 줄 용의도 있다.

findings.current: “We gather our very best and take out the head.”
findings.defect: The cooperative proposal marked by 칩시다 is rendered as a stiff declarative sentence.
findings.rationale: The source proposes a joint course of action rather than describing what they presently do.
findings.replacement: “Let’s gather our very best and take out the head.”

findings.current: “Think before you run your mouth. Stop watching those ‘warning: rear ahead’ GIFs on the internet and think about the rear in an actual war.”
findings.defect: “Warning: rear ahead” is not natural or intelligible English and loses the sexualized internet euphemism that enables Jin’s joke about the military rear.
findings.rationale: 후방 주의 is an online warning attached to risqué images; Jin deliberately contrasts that meaning of “rear” with the rear of an army.
findings.replacement: “Think before you run your mouth. Stop looking at those ‘watch your rear’ GIFs on the internet and think about the rear in an actual war.”
findings.source: “마, 생각하고 씨부려. 맨날 인터넷에서 후방 주의 움짤. 뭐 그딴 거나 보지 말고 진짜 전쟁에서의 후방을 생각하라고.”

findings.current: “The Arch Lich must have left a large number of high-level monsters behind for the final battle. There are far more of them than the number of A-rank Hunters on our side. To maintain even a remotely balanced battlefield, we need at least two more S-rank Hunters.”
findings.defect: “Even a remotely balanced battlefield” weakens 팽팽한 전황, which means an evenly matched or closely contested battle situation.
findings.rationale: Wei is specifying the force required to keep the two sides evenly matched, not merely to make the battlefield remotely balanced.
findings.replacement: “The Arch Lich must have left a large number of high-level monsters behind for the final battle. There are far more of them than the number of A-rank Hunters on our side. To maintain an evenly matched battlefield, we need at least two more S-rank Hunters.”
findings.source: “아크 리치는 마지막 전투를 위해 상위 몬스터들을 대거 남겨 두었을 거요. 아군이 보유한 A급 헌터의 숫자보다 훨씬 많지. 최소한 팽팽한 전황을 유지하기 위해서는 S급 헌터 둘이 더 필요하오.”

findings.current: “It’s fine. I don’t care. I’d actually prefer it this way. It would be awkward if the United Kingdom’s fourth in line to the throne were to suffer some misfortune during the operation I proposed.”
findings.defect: The draft inserts a standalone preference before giving its cause, weakening the source’s direct causal structure and deadpan delivery.
findings.rationale: 오히려 좋지 is explicitly caused by Jin’s reluctance to have a royal heir harmed during his operation, while 걸쩍지근하다 conveys an uneasy or unpleasant lingering feeling rather than generic awkwardness.
findings.replacement: “It’s fine. I don’t care. I’d actually prefer it this way, since it would leave a bad taste in my mouth if the United Kingdom’s fourth in line to the throne got hurt during the operation I proposed.”
findings.source: “괜찮아. 난 신경 안 써. 내가 제시한 작전에 영국 계승 서열 4위가 무슨 일이라도 당하면 걸쩍지근하니까 오히려 좋지.”

findings.current: “I hope you understand that this is not my own choice. However, since I have been bound to the royal family since birth, I cannot disobey His Majesty’s command—”
findings.defect: “His Majesty” removes the explicit father-son relationship and the elevated filial register of 아바마마.
findings.rationale: Felix specifically refers to the king as his father, not merely by the sovereign’s formal title.
findings.replacement: “I hope you understand that this is not my own choice. However, since I have been bound to the royal family since birth, I cannot disobey my royal father’s command—”
findings.source: 「내 자의가 아니라는 걸 알아줬으면 좋겠군. 다만 태어날 때부터 왕실에 매인 몸인지라 아바마마의 명을 거스를 수는…….」

findings.current: “Answer properly. If you answer like that, how the hell am I supposed to know whether you mean agreement or Donguibogam? Are you Heo Jun?”
findings.defect: The explanatory footnote is defined at the end of the chapter but has no reference marker in the prose.
findings.rationale: Adding the missing marker connects the culturally specific wordplay to the existing footnote and resolves the Markdown warning.
findings.replacement: “Answer properly. If you answer like that, how the hell am I supposed to know whether you mean agreement or Donguibogam[^1]? Are you Heo Jun?”
findings.source: “대답 똑바로 해라. 그따위로 대답하면 동의보감인지 뭔지 어떻게 알아 처먹어. 허준이야?”

findings.current: “Your academic credentials are pretty extensive. Still, they can’t beat my toilet-paper education.”
findings.defect: “Toilet-paper education” invents a concept absent from the source and obscures the euphemistic masturbation joke built on the contrast between 가방끈 and 휴지끈.
findings.rationale: The first expression refers idiomatically to education, while the second substitutes tissues to make a deliberately indirect sexual joke.
findings.replacement: “That’s an impressive amount of schooling. Still, it’s nothing compared to the length of my tissue roll.”
findings.source: “가방끈이 상당히 기시네요. 그래 봤자 제 휴지끈보다는 못하겠지만.”

findings.current: —Believe me. I promise there won’t be any danger.
findings.defect: “Believe me” changes Lee’s instruction. 받아들이게 tells Wu to accept the situation or outcome, not to believe Lee.
findings.rationale: Lee first asks whether Wu thinks he was betrayed, then orders him to accept what has happened before promising his safety.
findings.replacement: —Accept it. I promise there won’t be any danger.
findings.source: - 받아들이게. 아무런 위험도 없을 거라 약속하지.

findings.current: Then a black, glossy skull rolled out and stopped at my feet.
findings.defect: “Rolled out” reverses the movement. Jin is inside the tent, and the skull rolls back in under its edge toward his feet.
findings.rationale: 굴러와 indicates motion toward the narrator, following the movement of the tent’s bottom edge.
findings.replacement: Then a black, glossy skull rolled in and stopped at my feet.
findings.source: 스슥, 슥. 난데없이 텐트 밑단이 들썩이더니, 검은 광택이 흐르는 두개골 하나가 데굴데굴 굴러와 내 발 앞에서 멈췄다.

summary: The draft contains two altered physical actions, several meaningful losses of hierarchy, mechanism, and humor, and one unreferenced footnote.
